title: tc-memory-panel
description:
What an assistant remembers – grouped memories with filters, search, in-place editing, pause, forget with Undo, and
a master switch.

memories.description: The memories shown, grouped by their category

categories.description: Order of the groups and the choices for new memories – defaults to the categories in the order they appear

heading.description: The heading, and the group's name

maxHeight.description: Height of the list before it scrolls, in px

undoFor.description: How long Undo stays on the tray (Clean: in the card's last row), in ms. It waits while the pointer or focus is on the tray and starts over after; `Infinity` keeps it until the next forget (WCAG 2.2.1)

addedSource.description: Source given to memories added here

actionLabel.description: A button on the tray that fires tc-action – Undo takes its place for a moment

text.description: The remembered fact, one short sentence

source.description: Where it came from, ready to show, e.g. "From chat"

date.description: When it was learned, ready to show, e.g. "Oct 12"

paused.description: Kept, but not used in answers
